# Esbjerg Mave- og Tarmsygd. Afd.

Esbjerg Mave- og Tarmsygd. Afd. (Esbjerg Department of Gastroenterology and Bowel Disease) is a hospital department included in the DANIBD quality registry for inflammatory bowel disease treatment. The department has reported a re-operation rate of 14% for surgical procedures, which exceeds the development target of 8% [^src1]. This metric is tracked as part of Denmark's national quality improvement system for inflammatory bowel disease care, where re-operation rates within 30 days of primary surgery serve as a key indicator of surgical quality.

The re-operation rate figure places Esbjerg among the departments monitored in the 2024 DANIBD annual report, which documents both national and regional performance across multiple quality indicators for IBD treatment, including measures of biological medication monitoring and surgical outcomes [^src1].
